verdicts.evidence: Preflight.jl:209-211 resolve_hats docstring now reads: "`anchor` is whether the hat runs at full strength... It is unrelated to the `file#heading` anchors of [`Config.resolve_anchor`](@ref)." Explicit disambiguation with @ref link at the second sense's first use.

GBGCodingTools.jl:16-17 module docstring (first file read) now states: "An **instrument** is one of four review procedures: `check-docs`, `check-consistency`, `bug-hunt`, `audit-changes`." Grep for other instrument mentions (DocLints.jl:11-12, Gate.jl:11) shows they cross-link back via [`GBGCodingTools`](@ref).

GBGCodingTools.jl:22-23 glossary defines "The **gate**, [`gate`](@ref)..."; DocLints.jl:17 links [`GBGCodingTools.gate`](@ref) at first mention of "the closure gate"; TestHarness.jl:583 links [`GBGCodingTools.gate`](@ref) too, distinguishing it from TestHarness.gate. All three sites now cross-reference.

GBGCodingTools.jl:19 (module #1, before any of the 19 later modules) now states plainly: "A **lane** is one agent's share of a round — one surface, one territory, or one kind of change." Grep for other 'lane' definitions confirms no contradiction; Preflight.jl:223+ still lists fields but the concept is now stated up front.

GBGCodingTools.jl:20 module docstring states: "A **hat** is one persona of the `check-consistency` panel, reading the corpus from a single standpoint" — reached before Init.jl (#16) or Preflight.jl (#24). Preflight.jl:198 also restates the same defining sentence before the field list.

Reflection.jl:164 now reads "`exempt` — the [`GBGCodingTools.Ledger`](@ref)'s `[exemption.match]` predicate" — a qualified @ref link at first mention, per RULE.DOC.XLINK, resolving the bare/unlinked use the finding described.

GBGCodingTools.jl:21 module docstring defines: "A **Workflow** is the instrument's `workflow/*.js` script, launched by the session running the round." Schema.jl:41 restates it too. Reached before Schema.jl (#5), Preflight.jl (#24), Rounds.jl's later uses.
